name: hueyauto
steps: log (ngc/bugsweep: the collective pilot steps once per game frame with gains per game second, and the glide is timed in game time - at 16 ms wall ticks and 8 s of wall clock the headless run had flown ~3 s of the entry and still had the clutch in) practice autorotation as taught: 500 ft / 70 kt over the sea, roll the throttle to the idle detent (the freewheel opens, N2 and NR split), hold 324 rpm with the collective, flare at ~200 ft, power recovery by ~120 ft

eval (()=>{ const H=__G.H, c=__G.war.carrier; H.reset(new __G.THREE.Vector3(c.p.x + 300, 152, c.p.z + 300), 0.8, false, 1); H.vel.copy(H.forward()).multiplyScalar(36); __G.SY.grip = 1; __G.SY.auto = null; window.__mode = 'auto'; window.__c = 0.3; window.__lt = __G.war.time; window.__ap = setInterval(()=>{ const H=__G.H, dt = __G.war.time - window.__lt; if (dt <= 0) return; window.__lt = __G.war.time; if (window.__mode === 'auto') window.__c = Math.min(1, Math.max(0, window.__c + (H.rpm - 1.0) * 5 * dt)); else window.__c = Math.min(0.6, Math.max(0, window.__c + ((2 - H.vel.y) * 0.25 - (H.rpm < 0.95 ? 0.375 : 0)) * dt)); __G.HI.setCollective(window.__c); }, 16); return 1; })()

eval (()=>{ const H=__G.H; return {nr:+(H.rpm*324).toFixed(0), n2:+(H.n2*6600).toFixed(0), clutch:H.clutch, vs:+(H.vel.y*196.85).toFixed(0), ias:+H.ias.toFixed(0), coll:+H.c.coll.toFixed(2), psi:+H.torque.toFixed(1), pitch:+(H.attitude().pitch*57.3).toFixed(1), pedal:+H.c.ped.toFixed(2), hint:document.getElementById('hint').textContent}; })()
eval (()=>{ const H=__G.H; return {flarePeakNR:+(H.rpm*324).toFixed(0), agl:+H.agl.toFixed(1), gs:+Math.hypot(H.vel.x,H.vel.z).toFixed(1), vs:+H.vel.y.toFixed(1)}; })()
log power recovery: throttle open (PgUp), collective up

eval (()=>{ const H=__G.H; return {nr:+(H.rpm*324).toFixed(0), n2:+(H.n2*6600).toFixed(0), clutch:H.clutch, agl:+H.agl.toFixed(1), vs:+H.vel.y.toFixed(1), grip:+__G.SY.grip.toFixed(2), alive:__G.Z.alive}; })()
